title: Detection of B-Mode Polarization at Degree Angular Scales by BICEP2
central_claims: BICEP2 detects excess degree-scale B-mode power beyond lensed LCDM.
The excess fits r=0.20 in a tensor model, but published text explicitly cannot exclude dust explaining the entire excess.
Instrument and analysis techniques produce sensitive polarization maps and suppress instrumental systematics.

source_manifest.title: BICEP2/Keck and Planck: A Joint Analysis of BICEP2/Keck Array and Planck Data
source_manifest.finding: Joint multifrequency analysis detects correlated dust, finds no significant tensor-mode evidence, gives r<0.12 and detects lensing B modes at 7 sigma. Original-team overlap means not an independent replication.

source_manifest.title: Cheng and Huang: Constraint on primordial gravitational waves from joint BICEP2 and Planck dust data
source_manifest.finding: Independent joint analysis actually uses BICEP2 measurements with Planck dust information, finds no primordial-wave evidence and bounds r<0.083 in base model; produces differentiated constraints on inflation models.

source_manifest.title: Gott and Colley: Reanalysis of the BICEP2, Keck and Planck Data: No Evidence for Gravitational Radiation
source_manifest.finding: Independent map-correlation reanalysis uses BICEP2 and Keck data, reports revised noise estimate and r compatible with zero. This is a preprint, not proof of a consensus about the noise correction.

source_manifest.title: US Planck Data Center: Gravitational Waves from Early Universe Remain Elusive
source_manifest.finding: Project assessment says joint analysis yields no conclusive primordial-wave evidence while improving knowledge of foregrounds and future searches.

search_gaps: Original full PDF accessed; abstract, methods, foreground analysis and conclusions read in detail. June 2014 published-version arXiv v3 preserved without truncation.
Original-team joint analysis is not coded as independent. Independent 2017 source is a preprint; no blanket validation of its noise estimate.
No systematic synthesis, product adoption or superiority comparison established.
research.summary: The primordial-gravitational-wave interpretation was displaced by foreground-dust analysis, while the observed polarization data remained useful. Independent analyses reused the data to constrain tensor modes; this is a mixed scientific outcome, not a uniformly failed paper.
